_doc: Reviewed exceptions to the frontend dependency-advisory gate (scripts/frontend_audit_gate.py). Each names ONE advisory, says why it cannot be fixed yet and why it does not reach users, and EXPIRES: after the date the advisory fails the gate again and must be re-reviewed. Add one only when no patched release exists.

exceptions.reason: No patched braces release exists (every version up to 3.0.3 is affected; published 2026-09-18). Reached only through @graphql-codegen/cli -> micromatch -> braces, a development tool that generates TypeScript types from this repository's own GraphQL files. It never parses untrusted input and is not in the shipped bundle.
